product_one_liner.value: Maximum provides banks with an AI-native operating system that combines core banking, payments, cards, risk and operations infrastructure with agents that automate workflows and provide real-time visibility.

pricing_page.notes: The public homepage presents the product and navigation but no pricing page or pricing link.

named_customers.notes: One named customer/design partner, Emprise Bank, is publicly shown; the cited customer announcement does not show two names.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 11–50 employees, which cannot be narrowed reliably to one of the requested 11–20 or 21–50 bands.

eng_blog.notes: The newsroom index contains funding and press coverage, not at least two engineer-authored posts about building the product.

public_docs.notes: The homepage has no public product documentation, help center or developer-portal link.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open careers page lists software-engineering roles and no AI, ML, data-science, NLP, LLM or computer-vision title.

model_provider.notes: The reviewed public product, privacy/security and careers material describes AI but does not name an underlying model or provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The reviewed legal/accessibility pages name no SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR or PCI DSS certification.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The open careers page lists engineering roles and no SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative or account-executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: Maximum publicly emerged from stealth and introduced the product on 2026-08-03, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Public profiles show C-level leaders joining Maximum in 2026: Alex Steiner (Chief Revenue Officer, August), Andrew Dust (Chief Operating Officer, August), and Daniel Adams (Chief Risk Officer, June).

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable job postings do not name a CRM or sales/marketing system.
